 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Derek Mason and Middle Tennessee State football will try to go back over the .500 mark in a Conference USA clash of rivals.
 The Blue Raiders (4-4, 2-2 CUSA) host Western Kentucky (3-5, 2-2) on Nov. 7 (2:30 p.m., ESPN+ ).
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Blue Raiders have lost seven games in a row against the Hilltoppers in the "100 Miles of Hate" rivalry. MTSU had a two-game winning streak snapped with a 44-28 loss to Kennesaw State on Oct. 28 while WKU suffered a 35-21 loss to Delaware after winning consecutive games.
 Follow as the Daily News Journal provides live updates.
